name: brazil-cross-border-tax
description: Brazil cross-border income tax for calendar 2026 for individuals moving into or out of Brazil, residents receiving foreign income, Brazilian payers and non-residents receiving Brazilian income. Covers residence dates, departure communication and return, ordinary non-resident withholding, technical-service and royalty classification, the new outbound dividend withholding, capital gains, treaty and foreign-tax-credit checks, and residents' foreign financial investments under Lei 14.754. Trigger on saída definitiva, non-resident Brazil, IRRF exterior, foreign dividends Brazil, treaty relief, foreign tax credit and moving to Brazil. Detailed treaty rate schedules, pensions, controlled foreign companies, trusts, non-resident securities portfolios and social-security agreements need specialist analysis. Do not substitute a resident dividend threshold for the outbound rule.
